"""Second host of the shared statement run (block-kind clone group)."""


def run_host_two(base: int, extra: int) -> int:
    base = base + extra
    seg_01 = (
        base + 1
    )
    seg_02 = (
        base + 2
    )
    seg_03 = (
        base + 3
    )
    seg_04 = (
        base + 4
    )
    seg_05 = (
        base + 5
    )
    seg_06 = (
        base + 6
    )
    seg_07 = (
        base + 7
    )
    seg_08 = (
        base + 8
    )
    seg_09 = (
        base + 9
    )
    seg_10 = (
        base + 10
    )
    seg_11 = (
        base + 11
    )
    seg_12 = (
        base + 12
    )
    return seg_12 + extra
